__comment: Field crops (doc 309): the vegetables a Farmer grows on a farming zone's tilled soil. Read by
ContentRegistry (a save names its crops); FarmingSystem holds the fields and their plants.
display_name / plural_name: the crop in the field's window and in Events.
item: the good one tile gives at a harvest, tile_yield of them.
farmer_level: the Farmer level that may sow it. Any Farmer pulls it.
sow_seasons: the seasons it may be sown in. A starter crop is sown and pulled in its one season.
plan_seasons: how many seasons of a field's plan it takes, from the one it is sown in:
2 for a crop that is sown in one season and comes ripe in the next.
grow_days: game days from sowing to ripe, at full speed. Damp soil grows a crop faster
(task_config.json, farming.damp_growth), and nothing grows in winter.
needs_damp: it grows only in damp soil (within reach of water, or on a day of rain).
regrow_days: above 0, the plant stays after a picking and is ripe again after these days,
in winter too, until its seasons in the plan end (kale).
idea: one line for the field's window on what sets the crop apart.
models: the plant on its tile as a sprout, growing (from growing_from of its days,
task_config.json) and ripe; picked is a regrowing crop between pickings.

base:flora:radish.idea: A spring crop. Quick: up to four rounds a season, the first fresh food after winter.

base:flora:carrot.idea: A summer crop. Up to three rounds a season.

base:flora:turnip.idea: An autumn crop. Two rounds a season, and it keeps like apples: the winter root.

base:flora:cabbage.idea: Grows from spring to autumn. Slow and big: the most fresh food a tile, but it does not keep.

base:flora:onion.idea: Sown in spring and pulled in summer. It keeps the longest, so a summer field can feed the winter.

base:flora:pumpkin.idea: Sown in summer and cut in autumn. Thirsty: it grows only in damp soil. The biggest harvest of the year.

base:flora:kale.idea: Sown in autumn and picked again and again until spring: the only field food in winter.
